title: Magic move
summary: Each part of A flies on its own spring into the matching part of B; text cross-blurs; the box reshapes.
signature: magicMove(a, b, p, { duration, stagger, stiffness, damping })

params.name: duration
params.description: length of the transition in seconds; springs use it to keep their feel

params.name: stagger
params.description: delay between parts (as a fraction of the transition)

notes: Magic move: parts with the same `data-part` in A and B fly from A's place and size to B's, each on its own spring, a few frames apart; text parts scale evenly and cross-blur; parts only in A leave, parts only in B pop in. The box behind (background, border, corners) reshapes from A's to B's.
Stack A and B in one positioned slot (their parent); give the slot overflow:hidden to keep travel inside it.
Pass the real duration in seconds and call it through p = 1: that is when it hides the layers it made.
Parts match by data-part (label, title, body, meta, media…); unmatched parts leave or pop in.
when: a UI card changes state and parts carry over
